A.O. No. 108 of 2018 
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Sarvesh Agarwal and Mr. 
Bharat Tiwari, Advocates for the 
appellant. 
Heard. 
Admit. 
Issue notice to the respondents. 
Steps to be taken within a week. 
Lower court record be 
summoned. 
In the meantime, effect and 
operation of the award dated 
05.01.2018 passed by learned Motor 
Accident Claim Tribunal/IIIrd 
Additional District, Judge, Dehradun 
in M.A.C.P. No. 154 of 2009 shall 
remain stayed provided the appellant 
deposits 60% of the awarded amount 
on or before 30.04.2018. It is also 
provided that 50% of the amount so 
deposits may be released in favour of 
the claimants. 
Stay application being CLMA No. 
2994 of 2017 stands disposed of. 
 
(Manoj K. Tiwari, J.) 
 22.03.2018 
Mamta
